present_illness.present_illness: The upper right tooth has been loose for several months, affecting chewing and requiring extraction.

past_history.present_illness: The upper right tooth has been loose for several months, affecting chewing and requiring extraction.

oral_examination.oral_examination: *18, *16 Moderate to severe gingival recession, grade III looseness, (-), nothing special. CT shows alveolar bone resorption to the root tip

treatment_plan.notes: Avoid acidic foods within a week and avoid hot and cold stimulation. Maintain oral hygiene as directed by your doctor and rinse with mouthwash. Regular re-examination and follow-up treatment if any discomfort occurs.

source_handle: 86 local povidone-iodine disinfection and local infiltration anesthesia with bistriol. After the anesthesia takes effect, the gums are separated and the tooth extraction forceps are removed. Routinely scratch the tooth extraction wound and apply pressure to stop bleeding.
